name: Weighted Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent and heels planted, holding the plate in front of your chest.
Brace your abdomen and lean back slightly from the hips while keeping your spine long.
Rotate your torso smoothly to one side to bring the edge of the weight plate toward the floor beside your hip.
Twist back through center to the opposite hip, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Rotate through your chest and obliques rather than simply moving the plate side to side with your arms.
Keep your heels grounded if lifting your feet pulls your lower back into rounding.
